question:
Spot the error.

Water is boiling at 100 degrees Celsius (A) / under normal atmospheric pressure, (B) / whereas it freezes at zero degrees. (C)

options.text: Water is boiling at 100 degrees Celsius
whereas it freezes at zero degrees.

explanation: Scientific/universal truth हमेशा Simple Present में होता है: 'Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius' (Continuous नहीं)।

question:
Spot the error.

Ravi is wanting a new motorbike (A) / for his birthday and (B) / has been saving money for it. (C)

options.text: Ravi is wanting a new motorbike
has been saving money for it.

explanation: 'Want' stative verb है, इसका continuous form नहीं बनता: 'Ravi wants a new motorbike'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

At this moment, the doctors [operate] on the injured soldier in the emergency ward.
explanation: 'At this moment' चल रही action बताता है, इसलिए Present Continuous आता है: 'are operating'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

Listen! Someone [knocks] at the front door, so please go and open it.
explanation: 'Listen! / Look!' जैसे words चल रही action का संकेत हैं, इसलिए Present Continuous: 'is knocking'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

Many economists [are believing] that inflation will fall sharply next year.
explanation: 'Believe' मानसिक अवस्था बताने वाली stative verb है, इसका continuous form नहीं बनता: 'believe'।

question:
Spot the error.

My sister is leaving for Mumbai tomorrow (A) / by the morning flight (B) / to attend an important meeting. (C)

options.text: My sister is leaving for Mumbai tomorrow

explanation: तय (arranged) भविष्य की योजना के लिए Present Continuous (is leaving + tomorrow) सही है। कोई error नहीं।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

I [have just finished] reading the novel you recommended.
explanation: 'Just' के साथ Present Perfect (have just finished) आता है, इसलिए sentence सही है।

question:
Spot the error.

My brother has gone out just now (A) / and he will return (B) / in about an hour. (C)

options.text: My brother has gone out just now

explanation: 'Just now' (अभी-अभी बीता समय) के साथ Simple Past आता है, Present Perfect नहीं: 'went out just now'।

question:
Spot the error.

The peon is absent since last Monday (A) / and has not informed (B) / anyone in the office. (C)

options.text: The peon is absent since last Monday

explanation: 'Since + point of time' के साथ Present Perfect आता है: 'is absent since' → 'has been absent since'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

I [know] my neighbour for the last ten years and we have never quarrelled.
explanation: 'For + period' के साथ Present Perfect आता है, इसलिए 'know' → 'have known' (stative verb का continuous भी नहीं बनता)।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

He [is living] in Pune since he joined the army.
explanation: 'Since + Simple Past clause' के साथ main clause में Present Perfect (Continuous) आता है: 'has been living'।

question:
Spot the error.

I do not remember exactly how long (A) / the old man is living (B) / in this village near the river. (C)

options.text: I do not remember exactly how long
in this village near the river.

explanation: 'How long' के साथ चल रही अवधि बताने के लिए Present Perfect Continuous आता है: 'how long the old man has been living'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

Ever since my brother left for abroad, I [am missing] him very much.
explanation: 'Ever since + past' के साथ main clause में Present Perfect (Continuous) आता है: 'have been missing'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

This is the most interesting book that I [read] in my entire life.
explanation: Superlative degree के बाद 'that' clause में Present Perfect आता है: 'the most interesting book that I have read'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

So far, we [completed] only half of the syllabus, and the examination is only a month away.
explanation: 'So far' (अब तक) के साथ Present Perfect आता है: 'we have completed'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The company [has been losing] money for the last three years.
explanation: 'For the last three years' के साथ Present Perfect Continuous (has been losing) सही है, इसलिए कोई सुधार नहीं।

question:
Spot the error.

I have been waiting here since morning, (A) / but nobody has come (B) / to attend to me. (C)

options.text: I have been waiting here since morning,

explanation: 'Since morning' के साथ Present Perfect Continuous और 'nobody has come' में Present Perfect दोनों सही हैं। कोई error नहीं।

question:
Spot the error.

It has been five years (A) / since the company has launched (B) / its first mobile application. (C)
explanation: 'It has been + period + since' के बाद Simple Past आता है: 'since the company launched'।

question:
Spot the error.

The little boy is very excited because (A) / this is the first time that he flew (B) / in an aeroplane. (C)

options.text: The little boy is very excited because
this is the first time that he flew

explanation: 'This is the first time' के बाद Present Perfect आता है: 'that he has flown'।

question:
Spot the error.

The manager has not yet signed (A) / the documents that were submitted (B) / to his office last week. (C)

options.text: The manager has not yet signed

explanation: 'Not yet' के साथ Present Perfect (has not yet signed) सही है, और 'were submitted ... last week' में Simple Past सही है। कोई error नहीं।

question:
Spot the error.

Mahatma Gandhi has been born in Porbandar in 1869 (A) / and led the freedom movement (B) / against the British rule. (C)

options.text: Mahatma Gandhi has been born in Porbandar in 1869

explanation: Past के निश्चित समय (1869) और जन्म जैसी पूरी हो चुकी घटना के लिए Simple Past आता है: 'was born'।

question:
Spot the error.

The manager wanted to know (A) / why you did not went (B) / to the office yesterday. (C)
explanation: 'Did not' के बाद verb की पहली form (V1) आती है: 'did not go'।

question:
Spot the error.

The government has recently (A) / announced a new scheme and (B) / has gave relief to the farmers. (C)

options.text: has gave relief to the farmers.

explanation: Present Perfect = has/have + V3। 'has gave' → 'has given'।

question:
Spot the error.

He had went to the market (A) / before I reached (B) / his house. (C)

options.text: He had went to the market

explanation: Past Perfect = had + V3। 'had went' → 'had gone'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

She [has resigned] from the post of managing director two days ago.
explanation: 'Ago' के साथ Simple Past आता है: 'resigned ... two days ago'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

My uncle [has visited] London in 2015 for a conference.
explanation: Past के निश्चित साल (in 2015) के साथ Simple Past आता है: 'visited'।

question:
Spot the error.

Shakespeare lived in the sixteenth century (A) / and is famous for his tragedies (B) / but he has written many comedies too. (C)

options.text: Shakespeare lived in the sixteenth century
and is famous for his tragedies
but he has written many comedies too.

explanation: बीत चुके युग के व्यक्ति की बात Simple Past में कही जाती है: 'but he wrote many comedies too'।

question:
Spot the error.

India was under the British rule for nearly two centuries, (A) / and it was not until 1947 (B) / that India has become an independent nation. (C)

options.text: India was under the British rule for nearly two centuries,
that India has become an independent nation.

explanation: 'It was not until 1947 that...' के बाद Simple Past आता है: 'that India became'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

I [took] a bath when the lights suddenly went off.
explanation: चल रही action के लिए Past Continuous और बीच में आने वाली action के लिए Simple Past: 'was taking a bath when the lights went off'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

While I [was walking] in the park, I met an old friend.
explanation: 'While' के साथ चल रही action के लिए Past Continuous (was walking) सही है, इसलिए कोई सुधार नहीं।

question:
Spot the error.

My mother was cooking dinner in the kitchen (A) / when the unexpected guests (B) / arrived at our house. (C)

options.text: My mother was cooking dinner in the kitchen

explanation: चल रही action के लिए Past Continuous (was cooking) और बीच में आई action के लिए Simple Past (arrived) सही है। कोई error नहीं।

question:
Spot the error.

We were extremely tired because (A) / after the guests have left, we cleaned (B) / the entire house and went to bed. (C)

options.text: after the guests have left, we cleaned
the entire house and went to bed.

explanation: दो past actions में पहले हुई action के लिए Past Perfect आता है: 'after the guests had left'।

question:
Spot the error.

I realised that I have made a mistake (A) / as soon as I saw (B) / the result of the examination. (C)

options.text: I realised that I have made a mistake

explanation: 'Realised' (past) से पहले हुई action के लिए Past Perfect आता है: 'I had made a mistake'।

question:
Spot the error.

The train had already left (A) / when we reached (B) / the platform. (C)
explanation: पहले हुई action (had already left) और बाद की action (reached) का मेल सही है। कोई error नहीं।

question:
Spot the error.

He has worked in a bank for ten years (A) / before he started (B) / his own business. (C)

options.text: He has worked in a bank for ten years

explanation: 'Before he started' (past) से पहले की अवधि Past Perfect में आती है: 'had worked'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

By the time the bus finally arrived, he [was waiting] there for two hours.
explanation: 'By the time + Simple Past' के साथ पहले से चल रही लंबी action के लिए Past Perfect Continuous आता है: 'had been waiting'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

I wish I [studied] harder when I was in school.
explanation: बीते समय के पछतावे के लिए 'wish + Past Perfect' आता है: 'I wish I had studied harder'।

question:
Spot the error.

Looking at his friend's new motorcycle, (A) / Rahul wished that he has (B) / a similar one. (C)

options.text: Looking at his friend's new motorcycle,

explanation: 'Wished' (past) के बाद 'that' clause में past form आती है: 'wished that he had'।

question:
Spot the error.

He spoke so confidently (A) / as if he knows (B) / all the answers. (C)
explanation: 'As if' (अवास्तविक स्थिति) के साथ और past के संदर्भ में past tense आता है: 'as if he knew'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

When he was young, he [was used to swim] in the river every evening.
explanation: बीती आदत के लिए 'used to + V1' आता है ('be used to' का अर्थ 'आदी होना' है): 'used to swim'।

question:
Spot the error.

Rahul, you look like a sportsman, (A) / did you used to play cricket (B) / when you were in school? (C)

options.text: Rahul, you look like a sportsman,
did you used to play cricket

explanation: 'Did' के बाद 'use to' (V1 form) आता है: 'Did you use to play cricket'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

Hardly [did he reach] the station when the train started moving.
explanation: 'Hardly' के बाद Past Perfect में inversion आता है: 'Hardly had he reached ... when + Simple Past'।

question:
Spot the error.

The stranger came to my house, (A) / took his seat and (B) / starts talking about his problems. (C)

options.text: The stranger came to my house,

explanation: एक ही वाक्य में क्रियाओं की tense एक जैसी रहनी चाहिए: came, took, started।

question:
Spot the error.

He saved a portion of his salary every month (A) / and took a loan from the bank (B) / so that he can buy a house. (C)

options.text: He saved a portion of his salary every month
and took a loan from the bank
so that he can buy a house.

explanation: Main verb past (saved, took) है, इसलिए purpose clause में 'could' आता है: 'so that he could buy'।

question:
Spot the error.

Your teacher was waiting for you in the staffroom, (A) / but you did not turn up. (B) / When have you reached the school? (C)

options.text: Your teacher was waiting for you in the staffroom,
but you did not turn up.
When have you reached the school?

explanation: 'When' से पूछे गए प्रश्न में Present Perfect नहीं, Simple Past आता है: 'When did you reach the school?'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

If it [will rain] heavily tomorrow, the match between the two teams will be cancelled.
explanation: Condition वाले 'if' clause में future के लिए Simple Present आता है: 'If it rains'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

I will call you as soon as I [will reach] the airport tomorrow morning.
explanation: Time clause (as soon as, when, before) में future के लिए Simple Present आता है: 'as soon as I reach'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

Please wait here until the manager [will return] from the meeting.
explanation: 'Until' वाले clause में future के लिए Simple Present आता है: 'until the manager returns'।

question:
Spot the error.

Our principal is a very experienced man, (A) / and by next March (B) / he will be teaching in this school for twenty years. (C)

options.text: Our principal is a very experienced man,
he will be teaching in this school for twenty years.

explanation: 'By + future time' और अवधि (for twenty years) के साथ Future Perfect Continuous आता है: 'will have been teaching'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

By the end of this year, the engineers [will have completed] the entire bridge.
explanation: 'By the end of this year' के साथ Future Perfect (will have completed) सही है, इसलिए कोई सुधार नहीं।
